text:
maria: Heads-up — last 48h eu-west dedicated pools are fragmenting. Hot tenants with heavy egress are forcing small warm slices and we're burning burst credits + inter-zone bandwidth. 
kevin: Ugh. I saw the same on the billing dashboard, egress cost per-tenant shot up 2.3x during the weekend. Link: https://console.internal/billing/tenants/eu-west
olivia: Are these the same tenants that have frequent warmup traffic patterns? or is it a network tail issue?
raj: Quick summary from telemetry: high KV-cache churn + long-lived small allocations. Networking shows a lot of asymmetric egress (to S3 in us-east) causing cross-AZ flows.
maria: Right — the combo of small contiguous warm slots + cross-region egress means allocator refuses to coalesce, so we keep spinning up micro-slices. Cost and latency bad. :face_with_thermometer:
kevin: Two things to consider: 1) tag egress at tenant level to prefer local S3 mirrors or CDN, 2) temporarily carve out ephemeral VLANs with strict egress shaping so noisy tenants don't force dedicated fragmentation.
zane: Ephemeral VLANs? that might require infra changes but could be quick with CNI tweaks. We could tc-shape on the host to cap egress per-tenant and avoid saturating inter-rack links.
olivia: Example tc commands we used in heat experiments: 
```
# limit tenant egress to 200mbit
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 12
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:12 htb rate 200mbit ceil 200mbit
iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -m comment --comment "tenant:acme" -j MARK --set-mark 12
nft add rule inet fwmark fwmark 12 meta priority 12 counter accept
```
raj: Also propose an allocator policy tweak, sample below — low-risk canary: prefer coalescing small warm slots if egress-tag matches 
```
allocator:
  coalesce_threshold: 3
  egress_awareness:
    enabled: true
    prefer_local_mirror: true
    egress_tag_tolerance: 0.2
```
maria: Love the low-risk canary. Who owns the dedicated allocator policy rollout? @kevin?
kevin: Happy to own it. Plan: roll policy to one eu-west rack first, attach egress-tagging to those tenants, enable host tc shaping via a DaemonSet (olivia + zane pair). Monitor: warm-pool fragmentation, egress cost, cross-AZ bytes.
olivia: For the DaemonSet we'll push a tiny init container that applies tc rules based on tenant metadata from /etc/tenant-tags. We'll also emit prometheus metrics: tenant_egress_bps, tenant_egress_shaped_bps.
zane: I'll prototype the init container today. Quick note: need to bump CNI capability to allow marking by tenant id. Possibly use iptables nft fallback in the pod.
maria: deploy-bot: can we schedule a canary for wed 07:00 UTC? aim to run 24h, then evaluate.
deploy-bot: @maria scheduled: canary "egress-tag-vlan-shape-euw1" -> rollout window wed 07:00 UTC for 24h. Immutable changes will require an infra PR.
raj: Observability checklist: add query for cross_az_egress_bytes_by_tenant, warm_slice_count_by_tenant, allocator_coalesce_attempts. If we see >30% reduction in cross_az_egress and >15% reduction in warm_slice churn, it's a win.
kevin: Cost estimate: RBAC + DaemonSet + allocator small change -> infra cost minimal. Expected egress savings unknown but we can set budget guardrails.
maria: Action items: kevin -> infra PR for allocator canary, olivia+zane -> daemonset prototype + metrics, raj -> dashboard and alerts, maria -> coordinate canary and postmortem template.
kevin: I'll open PR 12345 and ping this thread.
olivia: Prototype container image pushed: registry/internal/egress-shaper:try1. Logs look clean.
zane: Running local test, marking works. Need to validate perf on p3 instances.
maria: Nice. Keep updates here. If anyone sees a live-cost spike, @maria @kevin please alert. :eyes:
